jobs.prompt: Build exactly what docs/plans/phase11-design.md specifies: tools/plan-preview.mjs with the exported names, signatures, return shapes and rules, and tests/plan-preview.test.mjs. Plain ESM for Node 20+, no dependencies; first line of each new file is `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`; tests use node:test and node:assert/strict, start with `import './_isolate-config.mjs';`, and use temporary directories. Import safeWritableDir and assertRegularOrMissing from tools/journal.mjs (do not rewrite them). Write only your declared output files and do not edit tools/swarm.mjs. Cover every rule in the design with a test: the estimate formulas (a goal manifest from manifestForGoal in tools/goal.mjs with 1 and 3 leads, and a manifest without leads), calibration ratios and clamps and no compounding, every risk code, subscription lanes costing 0, formatPreview text (including control characters in names), savePlan/loadPlan round trip, refusal of a bad id, a tampered manifest, a missing plan, an existing plan id and a symlinked .swarm/plans.
